summary: LogProstyle Inc., a Tokyo-based foreign private issuer listed on a U.S. exchange, filed a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing that beginning September 9, 2026 management will deliver an investor presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The filing contains no transaction terms, no stake, no price per share, no premium and no board recommendation or advisor. It is a routine disclosure of investor-relations materials under Rule 13a-16, expressly not deemed filed for Section 18 purposes. No special-situation event is present; no risk-arb angle applies. Watch only for any subsequent strategic announcement.
